conventions: Sides are the character's own (her LEFT forearm). The storyboard converts them to picture terms (D-013 rule 3). 'Not shown' means the script never places the object after this point; the state given is the last one on screen. Glimpses s1ga and s1gb inherit the s1a01 and s1b01 states of the beats they are cut from. For frame prompts, style.json characters.<id> character_lock and wardrobe_lock are the verbatim locks (D-021 decision 7); the look text below is the story state and must not be pasted over them.

kiran.static: Indian woman, 27, about 5 ft 3, slight and wiry. Oval face, wheat-brown skin, straight dark brows, large kajal-lined eyes, closed watchful mouth, no marks on the face. Black hair, centre parting with a thin line of red sindoor, low bun at the nape, two loose strands at the temples. Small round red bindi. Thin plain gold ring, about 8 mm, in the LEFT nostril. Small plain gold ear studs. Short black-bead mangalsutra with one small gold bead. Block henna, deep orange-brown, both hands, every period: one solid disc about 4 cm in each palm, every fingertip dipped to the first joint, backs plain, nails short and unpainted. Scar: LEFT forearm, outer side, a pale slightly shiny crescent about 4 cm tip to tip and 7 mm thick, centre about 5 cm (three fingers) above the wrist bone, curve toward the hand, horns toward the elbow; under the middle of the left cuff when the cuff is at rest. Spoken description, all paths: 'कलाई पे जला निशान, आधे चाँद जैसा' (s1e01 l29; echoed s1a03 l28). Footwear outside the bedroom: flat black toe-post sandals (style.json follows the sheet).

problems.line: s1b03 l05: '[quietly] उससे पहले मोहित की माँ के कंगन। नौ तोला।' / en 'Before that, Mohit's mother's gold bangles. Nine tola.' After l04 'पिछली party, बाईस तोला'. Writer's note (clarity_pass.fixes, C1 round 2): 'so Mohit's wedding is plainly the one before the last party'.
problems.problem: Bible timeline: Mohit's was wedding six, and Kiran has done weddings seven and eight since; tonight is the ninth. 'पिछली party' is wedding eight, so Mohit's is two weddings before it, not 'the one before'. No line on path B counts weddings, so a viewer cannot catch it (low), but the line states a different world fact from the bible and from Chhoti's 'नौ शादियाँ' on path A.
problems.fix: s1b03 l05 only, same length, same take budget: hi '[quietly] और मंदिर वाली शादी में मोहित की माँ के कंगन। नौ तोला।'; en 'And at the temple wedding, Mohit's mother's gold bangles. Nine tola.' It names the wedding without an ordinal (the C1 fault the rewrite fixed) and without placing it next to the last party. Keep 'मोहित' in the line for the b2 set-up 4 insert. Alternative, if S1 prefers: keep the line and change the bible to make Mohit's wedding the eighth, which would also need s1a02 l15 checked.
